 Apertura 2026 matchweek 13 – dates, kick-off times and TV coverage 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Matchday 12 of the Apertura 2026 has barely ended, and Matchday 13 is already about to begin, with a double matchweek bringing games in midweek.
 Two matchups stand out from the rest: Atlas against América, two teams near the top of the table, and Santos against Pumas, with Santos riding a five-game winning streak and looking for a sixth straight victory.
